whatsappMessage:
Hi The Pacifique Team,

I noticed your café has fantastic 4.0★ reviews with nearly 1,000 ratings in Kankarbagh, but you currently lack a dedicated mobile website for table reservations and menu browsing.

Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept design kiya hai — jisme instant table booking, interactive menu, aur direct WhatsApp inquiry integrate ki hai:

🔗 https://www.arclanestudios.space/sites/pacifique

Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Would love your honest feedback!

— Ameya Sharma, Arclane Studios
callScript: Hi Team at The Pacifique Café & Lounge, Ameya here from Arclane Studios. Maine aapke café ke liye ek custom live website concept banakar WhatsApp par share kiya tha. Bas ek minute check karna tha ki kya aapko link receive hua aur aapne demo glance kiya? Great! We tailored it specifically with instant table booking, a digital food menu, and mobile-first speed for customers in Kankarbagh. Aapko overall look aur concept kaisa laga? Agar aapko concept pasand aaye, to hum isme aapki exact dishes, actual photos, aur pricing setup karke live kar sakte hain. Jab bhi aap free hon batayein, we can connect on a quick 5-minute walkthrough.
